title: Beings say they will not allow nuclear war
summary: Richard Barth tells of Beings say they will not allow nuclear war, about September 1964 at Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Or communicating anything else is that they're not going to let it, you know, go to nuclear war. They needed to stop these missiles from launching.
they'll leave us alone unless we uh I mean, this is the sense I got that they would leave us alone unless we screwed up.
tellings.difference: Adds that they would leave humanity alone unless we 'screwed up'.
tellings.link_reason: The same message from Richard's encounter: the beings will not allow nuclear war.

as_told.title: Beings will not let humanity go to nuclear war

plain: In 1964, at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, a site that held nuclear missiles, a missile guard named Richard Barth says non-human beings took him, and that they made him understand they would not let the world "go to nuclear war". Barth tells it as something that happened to him, on an episode about his abduction. He says the beings "needed to stop these missiles from launching". Later in the same interview he adds his own sense that they "would leave us alone unless we screwed up". Both versions come from Barth himself: once he gives the warning, and once he adds that condition. If true, it would mean someone not human is keeping watch over our nuclear weapons.
